/-!
# Basis of `LinSols` in the even case

We give a basis of `LinSols` in the even case. This basis has the special property
that splits into two planes on which every point is a solution to the ACCs.
-/
universe v u

open Nat
open Finset
open BigOperators

namespace PureU1

variable {n : ℕ}

namespace VectorLikeEvenPlane

lemma n_cond₂ (n : ℕ) : 1 + ((n + n) + 1) = 2 * n.succ := by
  linarith

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the first `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenFst (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the second `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenSnd (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the first `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftFst (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the second `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftSnd (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd n j)))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the first `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftZero : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.castAdd ((n + n) + 1) 0))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the second `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftLast : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd (n + n) 0)))

    have h2 := h1 j
    have h3 : evenFst j = i := rfl
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i - n.succ, by omega⟩
    have h2 := h2 j
    have h3 : evenSnd j = i := by
      simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenSnd, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, j]
      omega
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.BasisLinear
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.VectorLike
/-!
# Basis of `LinSols` in the even case

We give a basis of `LinSols` in the even case. This basis has the special property
that splits into two planes on which every point is a solution to the ACCs.
-/
universe v u

open Nat
open Finset
open BigOperators

namespace PureU1

variable {n : ℕ}

namespace VectorLikeEvenPlane

lemma n_cond₂ (n : ℕ) : 1 + ((n + n) + 1) = 2 * n.succ := by
  linarith

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the first `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenFst (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the second `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenSnd (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the first `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftFst (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the second `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftSnd (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd n j)))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the first `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftZero : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.castAdd ((n + n) + 1) 0))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the second `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftLast : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd (n + n) 0)))

lemma ext_even (S T : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) (h1 : ∀ i, S (evenFst i) = T (evenFst i))
    (h2 : ∀ i, S (evenSnd i) = T (evenSnd i)) : S = T := by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i.val < n.succ
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i, hi⟩
    have h2 := h1 j
    have h3 : evenFst j = i := rfl
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i - n.succ, by omega⟩
    have h2 := h2 j
    have h3 : evenSnd j = i := by
      simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenSnd, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, j]
      omega
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2

lemma sum_even (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin n.succ, ((S ∘ evenFst) i + (S ∘ evenSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (n.succ + n.succ), S (Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (split_equal n.succ)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _=> rfl
  rw [h1, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rfl

lemma sum_evenShift (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = S evenShiftZero + S evenShiftLast +
    ∑ i : Fin n, ((S ∘ evenShiftFst) i + (S ∘ evenShiftSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (1 + ((n + n) + 1)), S (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (n_cond₂ n)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _ => rfl
  rw [h1]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Fin.isValue, sum_singleton, Function.comp_apply]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  apply congrArg
  rw [Rat.add_comm]
  rw [← Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  rfl

lemma evenShiftZero_eq_evenFst_zero : @evenShiftZero n = evenFst 0 := rfl

lemma evenShiftLast_eq_evenSnd_last: @evenShiftLast n = evenSnd (Fin.last n) := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff]
  simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenShiftLast, Fin.isValue, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd,
    Fin.val_eq_zero, add_zero, evenSnd, Fin.natAdd_last, Fin.val_last]
  omega

lemma evenShiftFst_eq_evenFst_succ (j : Fin n) : evenShiftFst j = evenFst j.succ := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenFst, evenShiftFst]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.val_succ]
  ring

lemma evenShiftSnd_eq_evenSnd_castSucc (j : Fin n) : evenShiftSnd j = evenSnd j.castSucc := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenSnd, evenShiftSnd]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_castSucc]
  ring_nf
  rw [Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
  ring

/-- The first part of the basis as charges. -/
def basisAsCharges (j : Fin n.succ) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges :=
  fun i =>
  if i = evenFst j then
    1
  else
    if i = evenSnd j then
      - 1
    else
      0

/-- The second part of the basis as charges. -/
def basis!AsCharges (j : Fin n) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges :=
  fun i =>
  if i = evenShiftFst j then
    1
  else
    if i = evenShiftSnd j then
      - 1
    else
      0

lemma basis_on_evenFst_self (j : Fin n.succ) : basisAsCharges j (evenFst j) = 1 := by
  simp [basisAsCharges]

lemma basis!_on_evenShiftFst_self (j : Fin n) : basis!AsCharges j (evenShiftFst j) = 1 := by
  simp [basis!AsCharges]

lemma basis_on_evenFst_other {k j : Fin n.succ} (h : k ≠ j) :
    basisAsCharges k (evenFst j) = 0 := by
  simp only [basisAsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges, evenFst, evenSnd]
  split
  · rename_i h1
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h1
    simp_all
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h
    simp_all
  · split
    · rename_i h1 h2
      simp_all
      rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h2
      simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_addNat] at h2
      omega
    · rfl

lemma basis_on_other {k : Fin n.succ} {j : Fin (2 * n.succ)} (h1 : j ≠ evenFst k)
    (h2 : j ≠ evenSnd k) : basisAsCharges k j = 0 := by
  simp only [basisAsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges]
  simp_all only [ne_eq, ↓reduceIte]

lemma basis!_on_other {k : Fin n} {j : Fin (2 * n.succ)} (h1 : j ≠ evenShiftFst k)
    (h2 : j ≠ evenShiftSnd k) : basis!AsCharges k j = 0 := by
  simp only [basis!AsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges]
  simp_all only [ne_eq, ↓reduceIte]

lemma basis!_on_evenShiftFst_other {k j : Fin n} (h : k ≠ j) :
    basis!AsCharges k (evenShiftFst j) = 0 := by
  simp only [basis!AsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges]
  simp only [evenShiftFst, succ_eq_add_one, evenShiftSnd]
  split
  · rename_i h1
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h1
    simp_all
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h
    simp_all
  · split
    · rename_i h1 h2
      simp_all
      rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h2
      simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_addNat, add_right_inj] at h2
      omega
    · rfl

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.BasisLinear
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.VectorLike
/-!
# Basis of `LinSols` in the even case

We give a basis of `LinSols` in the even case. This basis has the special property
that splits into two planes on which every point is a solution to the ACCs.
-/
universe v u

open Nat
open Finset
open BigOperators

namespace PureU1

variable {n : ℕ}

namespace VectorLikeEvenPlane

lemma n_cond₂ (n : ℕ) : 1 + ((n + n) + 1) = 2 * n.succ := by
  linarith

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the first `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenFst (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the second `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenSnd (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the first `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftFst (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the second `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftSnd (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd n j)))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the first `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftZero : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.castAdd ((n + n) + 1) 0))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the second `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftLast : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd (n + n) 0)))

lemma ext_even (S T : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) (h1 : ∀ i, S (evenFst i) = T (evenFst i))
    (h2 : ∀ i, S (evenSnd i) = T (evenSnd i)) : S = T := by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i.val < n.succ
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i, hi⟩
    have h2 := h1 j
    have h3 : evenFst j = i := rfl
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i - n.succ, by omega⟩
    have h2 := h2 j
    have h3 : evenSnd j = i := by
      simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenSnd, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, j]
      omega
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2

lemma sum_even (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin n.succ, ((S ∘ evenFst) i + (S ∘ evenSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (n.succ + n.succ), S (Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (split_equal n.succ)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _=> rfl
  rw [h1, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rfl

lemma sum_evenShift (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = S evenShiftZero + S evenShiftLast +
    ∑ i : Fin n, ((S ∘ evenShiftFst) i + (S ∘ evenShiftSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (1 + ((n + n) + 1)), S (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (n_cond₂ n)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _ => rfl
  rw [h1]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Fin.isValue, sum_singleton, Function.comp_apply]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  apply congrArg
  rw [Rat.add_comm]
  rw [← Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  rfl

lemma evenShiftZero_eq_evenFst_zero : @evenShiftZero n = evenFst 0 := rfl

lemma evenShiftLast_eq_evenSnd_last: @evenShiftLast n = evenSnd (Fin.last n) := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff]
  simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenShiftLast, Fin.isValue, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd,
    Fin.val_eq_zero, add_zero, evenSnd, Fin.natAdd_last, Fin.val_last]
  omega

lemma evenShiftFst_eq_evenFst_succ (j : Fin n) : evenShiftFst j = evenFst j.succ := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenFst, evenShiftFst]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.val_succ]
  ring

lemma evenShiftSnd_eq_evenSnd_castSucc (j : Fin n) : evenShiftSnd j = evenSnd j.castSucc := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenSnd, evenShiftSnd]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_castSucc]
  ring_nf
  rw [Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
  ring

def basisAsCharges (j : Fin n.succ) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges :=
  fun i =>
  if i = evenFst j then
    1
  else
    if i = evenSnd j then
      - 1
    else
      0

/-- The second part of the basis as charges. -/
def basis!AsCharges (j : Fin n) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges :=
  fun i =>
  if i = evenShiftFst j then
    1
  else
    if i = evenShiftSnd j then
      - 1
    else
      0

lemma basis_on_evenFst_self (j : Fin n.succ) : basisAsCharges j (evenFst j) = 1 := by
  simp [basisAsCharges]

lemma basis!_on_evenShiftFst_self (j : Fin n) : basis!AsCharges j (evenShiftFst j) = 1 := by
  simp [basis!AsCharges]

lemma basis_on_evenFst_other {k j : Fin n.succ} (h : k ≠ j) :
    basisAsCharges k (evenFst j) = 0 := by
  simp only [basisAsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges, evenFst, evenSnd]
  split
  · rename_i h1
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h1
    simp_all
    rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h
    simp_all
  · split
    · rename_i h1 h2
      simp_all
      rw [Fin.ext_iff] at h2
      simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_addNat] at h2
      omega
    · rfl

lemma basis_on_other {k : Fin n.succ} {j : Fin (2 * n.succ)} (h1 : j ≠ evenFst k)
    (h2 : j ≠ evenSnd k) : basisAsCharges k j = 0 := by
  simp only [basisAsCharges, succ_eq_add_one, PureU1_numberCharges]
  simp_all only [ne_eq, ↓reduceIte]

lemma basis!_on_other {k : Fin n} {j : Fin (2 * n.succ)} (h1 : j ≠ evenShiftFst k)
    (h2 : j ≠ evenShiftSnd k) : basis!AsCharges k j = 0 := by
  exact?

informal_statement: The set of natural numbers is partitioned into equivalence classes where two numbers are equivalent if their difference is even. This lemma establishes that for distinct classes, a specific function (`basisAsCharges`) evaluates to zero, indicating orthogonality between basis vectors of different classes.
informal_proof:
Consider the set of natural numbers partitioned into equivalence classes based on whether their difference is even:
- If two numbers are in the same class, their difference is even.
- If they are in different classes, their difference is odd.

The function `basisAsCharges k j` measures the interaction between elements from different classes. Since the classes are fundamentally distinct when their elements have odd differences, there is no overlap or interaction between their basis vectors. Therefore, the interaction function (`basisAsCharges k j`) yields zero when `k` and `j` belong to different classes. This aligns with the principle that orthogonal vectors have no component in each other's direction, resulting in a zero interaction.

that splits into two planes on which every point is a solution to the ACCs.

open Nat
open Finset
open BigOperators

namespace PureU1

variable {n : ℕ}

namespace VectorLikeEvenPlane

lemma n_cond₂ (n : ℕ) : 1 + ((n + n) + 1) = 2 * n.succ := by
  linarith

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the first `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenFst (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the second `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenSnd (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the first `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftFst (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the second `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftSnd (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd n j)))

  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftZero : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.castAdd ((n + n) + 1) 0))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the second `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftLast : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd (n + n) 0)))

    (h2 : ∀ i, S (evenSnd i) = T (evenSnd i)) : S = T := by
  funext i

  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i, hi⟩
    have h2 := h1 j
    have h3 : evenFst j = i := rfl
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i - n.succ, by omega⟩
    have h2 := h2 j
    have h3 : evenSnd j = i := by
      simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenSnd, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, j]
      omega
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2

    ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin n.succ, ((S ∘ evenFst) i + (S ∘ evenSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (n.succ + n.succ), S (Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) i) := by

  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (1 + ((n + n) + 1)), S (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (n_cond₂ n)).symm.toEquiv]

  simp only [univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Fin.isValue, sum_singleton, Function.comp_apply]

  apply congrArg

  rw [← Rat.add_assoc]

  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]

  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenFst, evenShiftFst]

# Basis of `LinSols` in the even case

We give a basis of `LinSols` in the even case. This basis has the special property
that splits into two planes on which every point is a solution to the ACCs.
-/
universe v u

open Nat
open Finset
open BigOperators

namespace PureU1

variable {n : ℕ}

namespace VectorLikeEvenPlane

lemma n_cond₂ (n : ℕ) : 1 + ((n + n) + 1) = 2 * n.succ := by
  linarith

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the first `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenFst (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the second `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenSnd (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the first `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftFst (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the second `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftSnd (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd n j)))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the first `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftZero : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.castAdd ((n + n) + 1) 0))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the second `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftLast : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd (n + n) 0)))

    (h2 : ∀ i, S (evenSnd i) = T (evenSnd i)) : S = T := by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i.val < n.succ
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i, hi⟩
    have h2 := h1 j
    have h3 : evenFst j = i := rfl
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i - n.succ, by omega⟩
    have h2 := h2 j
    have h3 : evenSnd j = i := by
      simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenSnd, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, j]
      omega
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2

    ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin n.succ, ((S ∘ evenFst) i + (S ∘ evenSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (n.succ + n.succ), S (Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) i) := by

    ∑ i : Fin n, ((S ∘ evenShiftFst) i + (S ∘ evenShiftSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (1 + ((n + n) + 1)), S (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (n_cond₂ n)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]

  rw [Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

  apply congrArg

  rw [← Rat.add_assoc]

  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.BasisLinear
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.VectorLike
/-!
# Basis of `LinSols` in the even case

We give a basis of `LinSols` in the even case. This basis has the special property
that splits into two planes on which every point is a solution to the ACCs.
-/
universe v u

open Nat
open Finset
open BigOperators

namespace PureU1

variable {n : ℕ}

namespace VectorLikeEvenPlane

lemma n_cond₂ (n : ℕ) : 1 + ((n + n) + 1) = 2 * n.succ := by
  linarith

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the first `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenFst (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the second `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenSnd (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the first `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftFst (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the second `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftSnd (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd n j)))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the first `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftZero : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.castAdd ((n + n) + 1) 0))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the second `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftLast : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd (n + n) 0)))

lemma ext_even (S T : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) (h1 : ∀ i, S (evenFst i) = T (evenFst i))
    (h2 : ∀ i, S (evenSnd i) = T (evenSnd i)) : S = T := by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i.val < n.succ
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i, hi⟩
    have h2 := h1 j
    have h3 : evenFst j = i := rfl
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i - n.succ, by omega⟩
    have h2 := h2 j
    have h3 : evenSnd j = i := by
      simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenSnd, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, j]
      omega
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2

lemma sum_even (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin n.succ, ((S ∘ evenFst) i + (S ∘ evenSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (n.succ + n.succ), S (Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (split_equal n.succ)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _=> rfl
  rw [h1, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rfl

lemma sum_evenShift (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = S evenShiftZero + S evenShiftLast +
    ∑ i : Fin n, ((S ∘ evenShiftFst) i + (S ∘ evenShiftSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (1 + ((n + n) + 1)), S (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (n_cond₂ n)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _ => rfl
  rw [h1]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Fin.isValue, sum_singleton, Function.comp_apply]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  apply congrArg
  rw [Rat.add_comm]
  rw [← Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  rfl

lemma evenShiftZero_eq_evenFst_zero : @evenShiftZero n = evenFst 0 := rfl

lemma evenShiftLast_eq_evenSnd_last: @evenShiftLast n = evenSnd (Fin.last n) := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff]
  simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenShiftLast, Fin.isValue, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd,
    Fin.val_eq_zero, add_zero, evenSnd, Fin.natAdd_last, Fin.val_last]
  omega

lemma evenShiftFst_eq_evenFst_succ (j : Fin n) : evenShiftFst j = evenFst j.succ := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenFst, evenShiftFst]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.val_succ]
  ring

lemma evenShiftSnd_eq_evenSnd_castSucc (j : Fin n) : evenShiftSnd j = evenSnd j.castSucc := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenSnd, evenShiftSnd]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_castSucc]
  ring_nf
  rw [Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
  ring

/-- The first part of the basis as charges. -/
def basisAsCharges (j : Fin n.succ) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges :=
  fun i =>
  if i = evenFst j then
    1
  else
    if i = evenSnd j then
      - 1
    else
      0

/-- The second part of the basis as charges. -/
def basis!AsCharges (j : Fin n) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges :=
  fun i =>
  if i = evenShiftFst j then
    1
  else
    if i = evenShiftSnd j then
      - 1
    else
      0

lemma basis_on_evenFst_self (j : Fin n.succ) : basisAsCharges j (evenFst j) = 1 := by
  simp [basisAsCharges]

lemma basis!_on_evenShiftFst_self (j : Fin n) : basis!AsCharges j (evenShiftFst j) = 1 := by
  exact?

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.BasisLinear
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.VectorLike
/-!
# Basis of `LinSols` in the even case

We give a basis of `LinSols` in the even case. This basis has the special property
that splits into two planes on which every point is a solution to the ACCs.
-/
universe v u

open Nat
open Finset
open BigOperators

namespace PureU1

variable {n : ℕ}

namespace VectorLikeEvenPlane

lemma n_cond₂ (n : ℕ) : 1 + ((n + n) + 1) = 2 * n.succ := by
  linarith

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the first `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenFst (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the second `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenSnd (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the first `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftFst (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the second `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftSnd (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd n j)))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the first `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftZero : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.castAdd ((n + n) + 1) 0))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the second `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftLast : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd (n + n) 0)))

lemma ext_even (S T : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) (h1 : ∀ i, S (evenFst i) = T (evenFst i))
    (h2 : ∀ i, S (evenSnd i) = T (evenSnd i)) : S = T := by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i.val < n.succ
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i, hi⟩
    have h2 := h1 j
    have h3 : evenFst j = i := rfl
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i - n.succ, by omega⟩
    have h2 := h2 j
    have h3 : evenSnd j = i := by
      simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenSnd, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, j]
      omega
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2

lemma sum_even (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin n.succ, ((S ∘ evenFst) i + (S ∘ evenSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (n.succ + n.succ), S (Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (split_equal n.succ)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _=> rfl
  rw [h1, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rfl

lemma sum_evenShift (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = S evenShiftZero + S evenShiftLast +
    ∑ i : Fin n, ((S ∘ evenShiftFst) i + (S ∘ evenShiftSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (1 + ((n + n) + 1)), S (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (n_cond₂ n)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _ => rfl
  rw [h1]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Fin.isValue, sum_singleton, Function.comp_apply]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  apply congrArg
  rw [Rat.add_comm]
  rw [← Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  rfl

lemma evenShiftZero_eq_evenFst_zero : @evenShiftZero n = evenFst 0 := rfl

lemma evenShiftLast_eq_evenSnd_last: @evenShiftLast n = evenSnd (Fin.last n) := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff]
  simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenShiftLast, Fin.isValue, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd,
    Fin.val_eq_zero, add_zero, evenSnd, Fin.natAdd_last, Fin.val_last]
  omega

lemma evenShiftFst_eq_evenFst_succ (j : Fin n) : evenShiftFst j = evenFst j.succ := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenFst, evenShiftFst]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.val_succ]
  ring

lemma evenShiftSnd_eq_evenSnd_castSucc (j : Fin n) : evenShiftSnd j = evenSnd j.castSucc := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenSnd, evenShiftSnd]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_castSucc]
  ring_nf
  rw [Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
  ring

/-- The first part of the basis as charges. -/
def basisAsCharges (j : Fin n.succ) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges :=
  fun i =>
  if i = evenFst j then
    1
  else
    if i = evenSnd j then
      - 1
    else
      0

/-- The second part of the basis as charges. -/
def basis!AsCharges (j : Fin n) : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ)).Charges :=
  fun i =>
  if i = evenShiftFst j then
    1
  else
    if i = evenShiftSnd j then
      - 1
    else
      0

lemma basis_on_evenFst_self (j : Fin n.succ) : basisAsCharges j (evenFst j) = 1 := by
  exact?

  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.BasisLinear
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.VectorLike
/-!
# Basis of `LinSols` in the even case

We give a basis of `LinSols` in the even case. This basis has the special property
that splits into two planes on which every point is a solution to the ACCs.
-/
universe v u

open Nat
open Finset
open BigOperators

namespace PureU1

variable {n : ℕ}

namespace VectorLikeEvenPlane

lemma n_cond₂ (n : ℕ) : 1 + ((n + n) + 1) = 2 * n.succ := by
  linarith

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the first `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenFst (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the second `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenSnd (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the first `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftFst (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the second `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftSnd (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd n j)))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the first `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftZero : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.castAdd ((n + n) + 1) 0))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the second `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftLast : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd (n + n) 0)))

lemma ext_even (S T : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) (h1 : ∀ i, S (evenFst i) = T (evenFst i))
    (h2 : ∀ i, S (evenSnd i) = T (evenSnd i)) : S = T := by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i.val < n.succ
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i, hi⟩
    have h2 := h1 j
    have h3 : evenFst j = i := rfl
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i - n.succ, by omega⟩
    have h2 := h2 j
    have h3 : evenSnd j = i := by
      simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenSnd, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, j]
      omega
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2

lemma sum_even (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin n.succ, ((S ∘ evenFst) i + (S ∘ evenSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (n.succ + n.succ), S (Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (split_equal n.succ)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _=> rfl
  rw [h1, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rfl

lemma sum_evenShift (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = S evenShiftZero + S evenShiftLast +
    ∑ i : Fin n, ((S ∘ evenShiftFst) i + (S ∘ evenShiftSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (1 + ((n + n) + 1)), S (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (n_cond₂ n)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _ => rfl
  rw [h1]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Fin.isValue, sum_singleton, Function.comp_apply]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  apply congrArg
  rw [Rat.add_comm]
  rw [← Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  rfl

lemma evenShiftZero_eq_evenFst_zero : @evenShiftZero n = evenFst 0 := rfl

lemma evenShiftLast_eq_evenSnd_last: @evenShiftLast n = evenSnd (Fin.last n) := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff]
  simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenShiftLast, Fin.isValue, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd,
    Fin.val_eq_zero, add_zero, evenSnd, Fin.natAdd_last, Fin.val_last]
  omega

lemma evenShiftFst_eq_evenFst_succ (j : Fin n) : evenShiftFst j = evenFst j.succ := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, evenFst, evenShiftFst]
  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.val_succ]
  ring

lemma evenShiftSnd_eq_evenSnd_castSucc (j : Fin n) : evenShiftSnd j = evenSnd j.castSucc := by

  simp only [Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.coe_castSucc]
  ring_nf
  rw [Nat.succ_eq_add_one]

We give a basis of `LinSols` in the even case. This basis has the special property
that splits into two planes on which every point is a solution to the ACCs.
-/
universe v u

open Nat
open Finset
open BigOperators

namespace PureU1

variable {n : ℕ}

namespace VectorLikeEvenPlane

lemma n_cond₂ (n : ℕ) : 1 + ((n + n) + 1) = 2 * n.succ := by
  linarith

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the first `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenFst (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n.succ` into `Fin (n.succ + n.succ)` via the second `n.succ`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenSnd (j : Fin n.succ) : Fin (2 * n.succ) :=
  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the first `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftFst (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the second `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftSnd (j : Fin n) : Fin (2 * n.succ) := Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n)
  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd n j)))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the first `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftZero : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.castAdd ((n + n) + 1) 0))

/-- The element of `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` corresponding to the second `1`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/
def evenShiftLast : Fin (2 * n.succ) := (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd (n + n) 0)))

lemma ext_even (S T : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) (h1 : ∀ i, S (evenFst i) = T (evenFst i))
    (h2 : ∀ i, S (evenSnd i) = T (evenSnd i)) : S = T := by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i.val < n.succ
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i, hi⟩
    have h2 := h1 j
    have h3 : evenFst j = i := rfl
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2
  · let j : Fin n.succ := ⟨i - n.succ, by omega⟩
    have h2 := h2 j
    have h3 : evenSnd j = i := by
      simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenSnd, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd, j]
      omega
    rw [h3] at h2
    exact h2

lemma sum_even (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin n.succ, ((S ∘ evenFst) i + (S ∘ evenSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (n.succ + n.succ), S (Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (split_equal n.succ)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _=> rfl
  rw [h1, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rfl

lemma sum_evenShift (S : Fin (2 * n.succ) → ℚ) :
    ∑ i, S i = S evenShiftZero + S evenShiftLast +
    ∑ i : Fin n, ((S ∘ evenShiftFst) i + (S ∘ evenShiftSnd) i) := by
  have h1 : ∑ i, S i = ∑ i : Fin (1 + ((n + n) + 1)), S (Fin.cast (n_cond₂ n) i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_equiv (Fin.castOrderIso (n_cond₂ n)).symm.toEquiv]
    · intro i
      simp only [mem_univ, Fin.symm_castOrderIso, RelIso.coe_fn_toEquiv]
    · exact fun _ _ => rfl
  rw [h1]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.sum_univ_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Fin.isValue, sum_singleton, Function.comp_apply]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  apply congrArg
  rw [Rat.add_comm]
  rw [← Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  repeat rw [Rat.add_assoc]
  nth_rewrite 2 [Rat.add_comm]
  rfl

lemma evenShiftZero_eq_evenFst_zero : @evenShiftZero n = evenFst 0 := rfl

lemma evenShiftLast_eq_evenSnd_last: @evenShiftLast n = evenSnd (Fin.last n) := by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff]
  simp only [succ_eq_add_one, evenShiftLast, Fin.isValue, Fin.coe_cast, Fin.coe_natAdd,
    Fin.val_eq_zero, add_zero, evenSnd, Fin.natAdd_last, Fin.val_last]
  omega

lemma evenShiftFst_eq_evenFst_succ (j : Fin n) : evenShiftFst j = evenFst j.succ := by
  exact?

variable {n : ℕ}
informal_statement: The function `evenShiftLast` is equivalent to `evenSnd_last` for all elements in the type `Fin n`.
informal_proof:
To establish the equivalence between `evenShiftLast` and `evenSnd_last` for all elements in `Fin n`, we proceed as follows:

1. **Understanding the Functions**: 
   - `evenShiftLast`: This function likely processes the elements of `Fin n` by shifting their indices and then checks if the resulting element is even.
   - `evenSnd_last`: This function directly checks if the last element of `Fin n` (after some operation) is even.

2. **Base Case**:

/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

informal_statement: Given a function \( S: \text{Fin}(2 \times n.succ) \to \mathbb{Q} \), the sum of \( S \) over all elements in \( \text{Fin}(2 \times n.succ) \) is equal to the sum of \( S \) evaluated at \( \text{evenShiftZero} \), plus the sum of \( S \) evaluated at \( \text{evenShiftLast} \), plus the sum of \( S \) over the first half and the second half of the domain, specifically \( \text{evenShiftFst} \) and \( \text{evenShiftSnd} \).
informal_proof:
First, we note that the sum over the entire domain \( \text{Fin}(2 \times n.succ) \) can be decomposed into the sum of its parts. Specifically, we can separate the first element and the last element, and then handle the remaining middle elements, which can themselves be further divided into two halves.

We begin by expressing the sum as follows:
\[
\sum_{i} S(i) = S(\text{evenShiftZero}) + \sum_{\text{remaining elements}} S(i) + \sum_{\text{middle elements}} S(i)
\]

Next, we consider the middle elements. By dividing the domain into two equal halves, one for \( \text{evenShiftFst} \) and one for \( \text{evenShiftSnd} \), we can express the sum over the middle elements as:
\[
\sum_{\text{middle elements}} S(i) = \sum_{\text{Fin } n} (\text{evenShiftFst}(S)(i) + \text{evenShiftSnd}(S)(i))
\]

Using the linearity of summation, we can distribute the sum over the addition:
\[
\sum_{\text{middle elements}} S(i) = \sum_{\text{Fin } n} \text{evenShiftFst}(S)(i) + \sum_{\text{Fin } n} \text{evenShiftSnd}(S)(i)
\]

Finally, we combine all the parts:
\[
\sum_{i} S(i) = S(\text{evenShiftZero}) + S(\text{evenShiftLast}) + \sum_{\text{Fin } n} \text{evenShiftFst}(S)(i) + \sum_{\text{Fin } n} \text{evenShiftSnd}(S)(i)
\]

This decomposition ensures that the sum over the entire domain is preserved when broken down into these components, thereby proving the original statement.

  linarith

  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/

  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.castAdd n.succ j)

  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/

  Fin.cast (split_equal n.succ) (Fin.natAdd n.succ j)

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the first `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/

  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd n j)))

/-- The inclusion of `Fin n` into `Fin (1 + (n + n + 1))` via the second `n`,
  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/

  (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castAdd 1 (Fin.natAdd n j)))

  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/

  casted into `Fin (2 * n.succ)`. -/

/--
Congruence in the function argument: if `a₁ = a₂` then `f a₁ = f a₂` for
any (nondependent) function `f`. This is more powerful than it might look at first, because
you can also use a lambda expression for `f` to prove that
`<something containing a₁> = <something containing a₂>`. This function is used
internally by tactics like `congr` and `simp` to apply equalities inside
subterms.

For more information: [Equality](https://lean-lang.org/theorem_proving_in_lean4/quantifiers_and_equality.html#equality)
-/

same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is

informal_statement: If two functions defined on a finite set with an even number of elements have the same values at all even-indexed positions, then the functions are equal.
informal_proof:
First, consider two functions S and T defined on a finite set with an even number of elements. Assume that for all even indices, the values of S and T are the same. Our goal is to show that S and T are equal as functions.

Since the domain has an even number of elements, we can partition it into pairs of consecutive indices. For each pair, one index is even and the other is odd. Given the assumption that S and T agree on even indices, we can use this fact to show that they must also agree on the odd indices.

Consider an arbitrary index in the domain. If it is even, then by the assumption, S and T have the same value at that index. If it is odd, we can express it in terms of an even index (by subtracting one) and use the previously established equality to show that S and T still agree.

Since this holds for all indices in the domain, we conclude that S and T are equal as functions.
